title: Social media
intro: Post your listings to your Facebook Pages and Instagram Business accounts, with captions in each language, now or at a time you choose.
notEnabled: Social posting is not switched on for your agency yet.

compose.title: Compose a post
compose.noAccounts: Connect a Facebook Page or Instagram account first.
compose.caption: Caption
compose.aiHint: Drafted in the background from the listing's facts; the one in the caption language is used if you leave the caption empty.
compose.whenHint: In your agency's time zone. Leave empty to keep a draft.

postErrors.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Meta did not confirm the post: check the Page before posting it again.
postErrors.LISTING_UNAVAILABLE: The listing is no longer public.
postErrors.NO_IMAGES: The listing has no ready images.

errors.SOCIAL_NOT_ENABLED: Social posting is not switched on for your agency yet.
errors.SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: This account is no longer connected.
errors.SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_NEEDS_RECONNECT: Connect the account again before posting to it.
errors.SOCIAL_POST_NOT_EDITABLE: This post can no longer change.
errors.SOCIAL_CONNECT_FAILED: Meta did not connect the accounts. Try again.
errors.SOCIAL_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: Meta did not answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the listing (public, with images ready), the caption and the time.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: The post changed meanwhile. Reload and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many changes. Try again later.
